blocks.html: Christmas, the most joyous season of all, is the time when our homes are decked with bright lights and colorful Holiday Décor. It is a time for family gatherings when precious memories are made. Not even the pandemic brought about by the dreadful COVID 19 could put a stop for Filipinos from celebrating.

Robinsons Land ARTabado wants the spirit of Christmas to come to life by inviting every kid to remember their happy and fun memories at Robinsons Malls through a drawing competition entitled: ChristmaSAYA sa Robinsons Malls.
Through this card making contest, ArtAblado wishes to encapsulate wonderful memories and immortalize them in Christmas Cards to be drawn by children from all over the Philippines.
The competition has two divisions, division 1 is open to Filipino children aged 6 – 8 years old while division 2 is open for Flilipino children aged 9 – 12 years old.

Participants may submit only one entry. Artwork should be a4 size (8.3 x 11.7 inches) paper or board, using the following media: colored or graphite pencil, ink, pastel, crayon, chalk, marker, or charcoal for drawing and acrylic, watercolor or oil for painting.

The contestant’s name must not appear on the artwork. Artwork and entry form should be submitted to the Facebook messenger of ARTablado on or before October 15 for the preliminary judging. This should contain name, birthday, age, contact number, title of the artwork, a brief description about the piece (fifty words or less).

Finalists will be announced on November and winning entries will be announced on December. Winners for both division will get P15,000.00 in cash and a certificate. Second prize winners get P10,000.00 in cash and a certificate. Third prize winners get P5,000.00 in cash and a certificate. Up to 22 finalists will be selected for both division, each of whom will be handed P2,000.00 in cash. Special award will also be given the winners will receive P3,000.00. All winning entries will also be part of the 2021 Robinsons Land ARTablado collection and will be exhibited at ARTablado. Winning designs will also be used for RLC’s Christmas cards and collateral materials.
For the complete list of 2021 Robinsons Land ARTablado Painting Competition’s rules and regulations, visit the ARTablado Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/ARTablado
